cause: The page CSP did not constrain the worker's own execution environment. A getter on globalThis.fetch did not remove the prototype's native fetch or the authority available in newly created workers/module loads.
fix: Vite emits the sandbox entry under a dedicated asset namespace. Tauri attaches the shared independent CSP to that worker response, with connect-src none and worker-src none; script-src permits only host/plugin assets and Wasm compilation. Dev worker responses use the same policy. Product builds reject a missing or duplicate protected worker namespace.
